featured_reviews.name: Sulabh Sanjay
featured_reviews.review_text: We visited Kerala Café, Vasai after seeing several recommendations on Instagram reels. Being a Malayalee, I was quite eager to try it out. We went in the afternoon and were asked by one of the waiters to wait outside due to crowding. My family and I waited patiently, but after a while, we noticed other groups being seated, eating, and leaving, while we were still waiting outside.When we followed up, we realized that the waiter had completely forgotten about us. Each time we asked, he simply said that the tables were being cleaned, but in reality, other waiting groups were being seated before us. It clearly showed complete mismanagement and a lack of real interest in customer service.The ambience was nice enough, but the food was not as tasty as expected and definitely not worth the hype. The prices were also quite high for the quality offered. To make it worse, there was a lot of noise coming from the kitchen almost as if a fight was going on inside, haha.It seems that the restaurant relies heavily on social media popularity rather than genuine service or taste. Overall, it was a huge disappointment; we ended up waiting for nearly an hour due to their poor management, making it a regrettable experience for me and my family.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi! Sulabh,
This experience is very concerning, and I sincerely apologize for the lack of attention and care you received during your visit. The situation you described regarding the seating mismanagement is unacceptable, and we are taking immediate steps to ensure better communication among our staff to prevent this from happening in the future. Your feedback will be a catalyst for improving our service standards.
Regards,
Team Kerala Cafe, Vasai

Visited Dakshina Katha expecting an authentic South Indian breakfast, but it turned out to be quite disappointing.

We ordered benne masala dosa, Mysore masala dosa, ghee podi thatte idli, and filter coffee. The benne masala dosa was extremely doughy and not crispy at all, more like a kal dosa. The Mysore masala dosa felt like a plain regular dosa you’d get anywhere, nothing special. The ghee podi thatte idli, wasn't soft and lacked ghee and podi. Visited Priya Hotel on 11th May 2026 for my wedding anniversary around 11:20 PM. Their order-taking time was till 11:30 PM, yet they gave us a table and asked us to place the order. We initially wanted to order starters first and then decide the main course later, which is completely normal while dining. But the staff forced us to place the entire order immediately, saying the kitchen would close in 5 minutes.

We still cooperated and ordered starters, main course, rice, and dessert together. Later, the manager himself told us that rice would still be available after 11:30 PM. But when we asked for one plate of rice later during the meal, the same manager rudely denied it and said nothing was available. When we questioned this, he arrogantly replied that we should have checked the menu card because the timings were already mentioned there. If the timings were such a strict issue, then why even give us a table and waste our time instead of politely refusing us at the entrance itself?

The manager was extremely rude, arrogant, and unwelcoming throughout. It completely spoiled our anniversary mood. On top of that, they dumped all the food — starters, main course, and dessert — on the table together without any proper serving sequence. The table was overcrowded and the entire dining experience felt chaotic.

The service was terrible. No one was there to properly serve or assist us. The staff behaved as if they were doing us a favor by serving food, instead of treating customers with basic hospitality and respect.

A special day was completely ruined because of the poor management, rude behavior, and pathetic service. I would genuinely suggest people not choose this place for any special occasion.
